business_problem: WINDTRE needed to automate and accelerate claims handling for telecom service issues because high report volumes, stateful operational complexity, and repetitive service-desk tasks were slowing response times and consuming staff effort.
solution_summary: WINDTRE and IBM built an “Intelligent Automation” platform on IBM Cloud to analyze, enrich, route, and resolve service complaints with minimal human effort. IBM Consulting designed and manages the solution, using watsonx Assistant to classify incoming reports, Watson Knowledge Studio to build domain-specific annotators, and Watson Natural Language Understanding to extract relevant facts from unstructured ticket text. Once the AI layer completes the analysis, the ticket is enriched with information pulled from WINDTRE’s internal systems and passed to robotic process automation components—a dispatcher that queues work and performer robots that execute the resolution actions. Because the RPA runs on cloud virtual machines, WINDTRE can scale multiple robots in parallel while dashboards continuously track volume, performance, and benefits. The result is a claims-management workflow that blends NLP, AI classification, ticket enrichment, and RPA so the service desk can focus on higher-value problems while routine issues are resolved or routed automatically.

business_outcome: WINDTRE automated a large portion of complaints handling, dramatically improved response time, reduced repetitive desk work, and created a foundation for expanding AI and analytics into infrastructure-incident management.
